6:  * The LSM6DS3TR-C registers through the in-tree NuttX lsm6dsl driver at

10:  * the raw I2C char device /dev/i2c1 (the sensor bus).

54: #define G_MS2  9.80665f

56: static uint32_t get_time_ms(void)
57: {
58:     struct timeval tv;
59:     gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
60:     return (uint32_t)(tv.tv_sec * 1000 + tv.tv_usec / 1000);

63: static inline float wrap_deg(float deg)
64: {
65:     while (deg >= 180.0f) deg -= 360.0f;
66:     while (deg < -180.0f) deg += 360.0f;
67:     return deg;
68: }

73: {
74:     memset(mgr, 0, sizeof(*mgr));

76:     mgr->imu.present = false;

101: /* gyro zero-bias calibration: average the raw gyro while the watch is
102:  * held still right after boot (removes the largest yaw-drift source) */
103: static void gyro_calibrate_bias(sensor_manager_t *mgr)
104: {
105:     struct lsm6dsl_sensor_data_s sdata;
106:     double sum_x = 0, sum_y = 0, sum_z = 0;
107:     int n = 0;
108:     uint32_t t0 = get_time_ms();
109: 
110:     while (get_time_ms() - t0 < 2000 && n < 80)
111:     {
112:         if (ioctl(g_imu_fd, SNIOC_LSM6DSLSENSORREAD,
113:                   (unsigned long)&sdata) == 0)
114:         {
115:             sum_x += sdata.g_x_data;
116:             sum_y += sdata.g_y_data;
117:             sum_z += sdata.g_z_data;
118:             n++;
119:         }
120:         usleep(20000);
121:     }
122:     if (n > 10)
123:     {
124:         mgr->gyro_bias_z = (float)(sum_z / n) / 1000.0f;
125:         mgr->gyro_bias_x = (float)(sum_x / n) / 1000.0f;
126:         mgr->gyro_bias_y = (float)(sum_y / n) / 1000.0f;
127:     }
128:         printf("[IMU] gyro bias=(%.2f,%.2f,%.2f) deg/s (n=%d)\n",
129:            mgr->gyro_bias_x, mgr->gyro_bias_y, mgr->gyro_bias_z, n);
130: }
131: 
132: static void sensor_update_imu(sensor_manager_t *mgr)
133: {
134:     struct lsm6dsl_sensor_data_s sdata;
135:     imu_t *imu = &mgr->imu;
136:     float accel_mag, accel_diff, tilt;
137:     uint32_t now = get_time_ms();
138: 
139:     if (!imu->present || g_imu_fd < 0)
140:         return;
141: 
142:     /* one-time zero-bias calibration at the first sample */
143:     if (!mgr->gyro_bias_calibrated)
144:     {
145:         mgr->gyro_bias_calibrated = true;
146:         gyro_calibrate_bias(mgr);
147:     }
148: 
149:     if (ioctl(g_imu_fd, SNIOC_LSM6DSLSENSORREAD, (unsigned long)&sdata) == 0)
150:     {
151:         imu->ax = sdata.x_data * G_MS2 / 1000.0f;
152:         imu->ay = sdata.y_data * G_MS2 / 1000.0f;
153:         imu->az = sdata.z_data * G_MS2 / 1000.0f;
154:         imu->gx = sdata.g_x_data / 1000.0f - mgr->gyro_bias_x;
155:         imu->gy = sdata.g_y_data / 1000.0f - mgr->gyro_bias_y;
156:         imu->gz = sdata.g_z_data / 1000.0f - mgr->gyro_bias_z;
157:         imu->temperature_c = (float)sdata.temperature;
158: 
159:         /* integrate the gyro around the GRAVITY axis (the horizontal
160:          * yaw of the whole body), not the raw Z axis: on the wrist the
161:          * raw Z mixes arm swings with body turns.  Project the gyro
162:          * vector onto the accelerometer-derived gravity direction, so a
163:          * body turn changes the bearing but swinging the arm does not.
164:          *   - deadband: ignore < 15 deg/s (stillness / slow sway)
165:          *   - clamp per-sample delta to +-2 deg
166:          *   - low-pass the displayed value */
167:         if (imu->last_sample_ms != 0)
168:         {
169:             float dt = (float)(now - imu->last_sample_ms) / 1000.0f;
170:             if (dt > 0.0f && dt < 0.5f)
171:             {
172:                 float amag = sqrtf(imu->ax * imu->ax +
173:                                    imu->ay * imu->ay +
174:                                    imu->az * imu->az);
175:                 float w_yaw = 0.0f;
176:                 float delta;
177: 
178:                 if (amag > 0.5f)
179:                 {
180:                     /* unit gravity direction, only refreshed while the
181:                      * watch is near-quiescent (|a| ~= 1g): under motion
182:                      * the linear acceleration corrupts the gravity
183:                      * estimate and projects the gyro onto a wrong axis
184:                      * (turns come out 90 deg off / jump around) */
185:                     if (fabsf(amag - 9.81f) < 2.5f)
186:                     {
187:                         mgr->gravity_x = imu->ax / amag;
188:                         mgr->gravity_y = imu->ay / amag;
189:                         mgr->gravity_z = imu->az / amag;
190:                         mgr->gravity_valid = true;
191:                     }
192:                     if (mgr->gravity_valid)
193:                     {
194:                         /* gyro (deg/s) projected on the stable gravity
195:                          * axis = horizontal yaw rate */
196:                         w_yaw = imu->gx * mgr->gravity_x +
197:                                 imu->gy * mgr->gravity_y +
198:                                 imu->gz * mgr->gravity_z;
199:                     }
200:                 }
201:                 if (w_yaw > -15.0f && w_yaw < 15.0f)
202:                     w_yaw = 0.0f;
203:                 mgr->gyro_yaw_rate = w_yaw;
204:                 delta = w_yaw * dt;
205:                 if (delta > 2.0f) delta = 2.0f;
206:                 if (delta < -2.0f) delta = -2.0f;
207:                 /* positive yaw rate (CCW seen from above) = turn LEFT,
208:                  * compass bearing decreases */
209:                 mgr->gyro_yaw_deg -= delta;
210:                 while (mgr->gyro_yaw_deg >= 360.0f)
211:                     mgr->gyro_yaw_deg -= 360.0f;
212:                 while (mgr->gyro_yaw_deg < 0.0f)
213:                     mgr->gyro_yaw_deg += 360.0f;
214:             }
215:             mgr->gyro_yaw_valid = true;
216:         }
217:         /* low-pass the displayed bearing */
218:         {
219:             float diff = mgr->gyro_yaw_deg - mgr->gyro_yaw_disp;
220:             if (diff > 180.0f) diff -= 360.0f;
221:             else if (diff < -180.0f) diff += 360.0f;
222:             mgr->gyro_yaw_disp += diff * 0.12f;
223:             while (mgr->gyro_yaw_disp >= 360.0f)
224:                 mgr->gyro_yaw_disp -= 360.0f;
225:             while (mgr->gyro_yaw_disp < 0.0f)
226:                 mgr->gyro_yaw_disp += 360.0f;
227:         }
228:         imu->last_sample_ms = now;
229: 
230:         accel_mag = sqrtf(imu->ax * imu->ax + imu->ay * imu->ay +
231:                           imu->az * imu->az);
232:         accel_diff = fabsf(accel_mag - G_MS2);
233: 
234:         /* pitch from accelerometer (deg) */
235:         tilt = atan2f(imu->ax, sqrtf(imu->ay * imu->ay + imu->az * imu->az)) *
236:                57.29578f;
237:         imu->pitch = tilt;
238:         imu->roll  = atan2f(imu->ay,
239:                             sqrtf(imu->ax * imu->ax + imu->az * imu->az)) *
240:                      57.29578f;
241: 
242:         /* running / moving detection */
243:         if (accel_diff < 0.15f * G_MS2)
244:         {
245:             if (imu->moving)
246:             {
247:                 imu->stationary_start_ms = now;
248:                 imu->moving = false;
249:             }
250:         }
251:         else
252:         {
253:             imu->moving = true;
254:             imu->stationary_start_ms = 0;
255:         }
256: 
257:         /* view lock: freeze map rotation while the runner is moving, so
258:          * the route preview does not jitter; unlock 3 s after stopping. */
259:         if (imu->moving)
260:         {
261:             imu->view_locked = true;
262:         }
263:         else if (imu->stationary_start_ms &&
264:                  now - imu->stationary_start_ms >
265:                      IMU_VIEW_LOCK_STATIONARY_S * 1000)
266:         {
267:             imu->view_locked = false;
268:         }
269: 
270:         /* raise-to-wake: a wrist lift shows as a short accel spike with
271:          * the watch tilted towards a viewing angle */
272:         imu->raise_detected = false;
273:         if (accel_diff > IMU_RAISE_ACCEL_MS2 &&
274:             tilt > -60.0f && tilt < 60.0f &&
275:             now - imu->last_raise_ms > IMU_RAISE_COOLDOWN_MS)
276:         {
277:             imu->raise_detected = true;
278:             imu->last_raise_ms = now;
279:         }
280:     }
281: }

283: static void sensor_fuse_heading(sensor_manager_t *mgr, uint32_t now)
284: {
285:     float mag_h, hdelta;
286: 
287:     /* the magnetometer is authoritative whenever it reports a sane
288:      * field; the gyro bearing is only a fallback if it is absent */
289:     mgr->mag_healthy = (mgr->mag.present && mgr->mag.healthy);
290: 
291:     if (!mgr->mag_healthy)
292:     {
293:         mgr->heading_deg = mgr->gyro_yaw_disp;
294:         mgr->heading_mag_deg = mgr->gyro_yaw_disp;
295:         return;
296:     }
297: 
298:     /* tilt-compensated heading: project the 3D field onto the plane
299:      * perpendicular to gravity, so tilting the watch does not swing the
300:      * bearing (standard compass algorithm, same gravity vector the gyro
301:      * yaw already uses) */
302:     if (mgr->gravity_valid)
303:     {
304:         float mx = mgr->mag.x_g, my = mgr->mag.y_g, mz = mgr->mag.z_g;
305:         float ux = mgr->gravity_x, uy = mgr->gravity_y, uz = mgr->gravity_z;
306:         float dot = mx * ux + my * uy + mz * uz;
307:         float ox = mx - dot * ux;
308:         float oy = my - dot * uy;
309:         mag_h = atan2f(-oy, ox) * 57.29578f;
310:         if (mag_h < 0.0f)
311:             mag_h += 360.0f;
312:         /* watch face-down: the sensor X/Y axes flip relative to the
313:          * world, so flip the bearing 180 deg to stay continuous
314:          * (uz is the gravity component along the sensor Z axis) */
315:         if (uz < 0.0f)
316:         {
317:             mag_h += 180.0f;
318:             if (mag_h >= 360.0f)
319:                 mag_h -= 360.0f;
320:         }
321:     }
322:     else
323:     {
324:         mag_h = mgr->mag.heading_deg;
325:     }
326:     mgr->heading_mag_deg = mag_h;
327: 
328:     if (!mgr->heading_valid)
329:     {
330:         mgr->heading_deg = mag_h;
331:         mgr->heading_valid = true;
332:     }
333:     else
334:     {
335:         /* wrap-aware quick fuse with a dead band: small noise does not
336:          * move the needle at all, real turns follow fast */
337:         hdelta = wrap_deg(mag_h - mgr->heading_deg);
338:         if (hdelta > 2.0f || hdelta < -2.0f)
339:             mgr->heading_deg = wrap_deg(mgr->heading_deg + hdelta * 0.50f);
340:     }
341:     mgr->last_fusion_ms = now;
342: }
343: 
344: static void sensor_update_als(sensor_manager_t *mgr)
345: {
346:     uint16_t lux;
347: 
348:     if (!mgr->als.present)
349:         return;
350: 
351:     if (als_ltr303_read(&mgr->als) < 0)
352:         return;
353: 
354:     lux = mgr->als.filtered_lux;
355: 
356:     /* brightness %: outdoor daylight gets full brightness, night dims */
357:     if (lux < 10)         mgr->backlight_pct = 50;
358:     else if (lux < 100)   mgr->backlight_pct = 60;
359:     else if (lux < 500)   mgr->backlight_pct = 70;
360:     else if (lux < 2000)  mgr->backlight_pct = 85;
361:     else if (lux < 10000) mgr->backlight_pct = 95;
362:     else                  mgr->backlight_pct = 100;
363: }
364: 
365: void sensor_update(sensor_manager_t *mgr)
366: {
367:     uint32_t now = get_time_ms();
368: 
369: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_SIM
370:     /* Host simulator: no sensor devices, feed simulated data so the
371:      * whole render/interact pipeline can be exercised.  The heading
372:      * sweeps a full circle every ~18 s (continuous map rotation). */
373:     if (!mgr->mag.present && !mgr->imu.present)
374:     {
375:         static uint32_t t0;
376:         if (t0 == 0)
377:             t0 = now;
378:         mgr->heading_deg = fmodf((float)(now - t0) * 0.02f, 360.0f);
379:         if (mgr->heading_deg < 0.0f)
380:             mgr->heading_deg += 360.0f;
381:         mgr->heading_mag_deg = mgr->heading_deg;
382:         mgr->heading_valid = true;
383:         /* NOTE: do not set imu.present here - the branch below triggers
384:          * on "no devices present" and would stop feeding the simulated
385:          * heading once present turns true. */
386:         mgr->imu.ax = 0.0f;
387:         mgr->imu.ay = 0.0f;
388:         mgr->imu.az = -9.81f;
389:         mgr->als.present = true;
390:         mgr->als.filtered_lux = 300;
391:         mgr->backlight_pct = 45;
392:         return;
393:     }
394: #endif
395: 
396:     sensor_update_imu(mgr);
397:     if (mgr->mag.calib_running)
398:         mag_mmc5603_calib_step(&mgr->mag);
399:     else
400:         mag_mmc5603_read(&mgr->mag);
401: 
402:     {
403:         static int dbg = 0;
404:         if (dbg < 40)
405:         {
406:             printf("[Fuse] yaw=%.0f mx=%.0f my=%.0f mz=%.0f ok=%d cal=%d off=(%.0f,%.0f,%.0f) gz=%.1f\n",
407:                    mgr->heading_deg,
408:                    mgr->mag.x_g, mgr->mag.y_g, mgr->mag.z_g,
409:                    (int)mgr->mag.healthy, (int)mgr->mag.calibrated,
410:                    mgr->mag.offset_x, mgr->mag.offset_y, mgr->mag.offset_z,
411:                    mgr->imu.gz);
412:             dbg++;
413:         }
414:     }
415: 
416:     /* Madgwick 9-axis AHRS -> world-frame heading.  Unlike a flat
417:      * atan2 or a gravity-plane projection this fuses gyro+accel+mag
418:      * into a full orientation quaternion, so the bearing is correct in
419:      * ANY watch pose (phone-grade compass). */
420:     if (mgr->mag.present && mgr->mag.healthy)
421:     {
422:         float dt = (float)(now - mgr->imu.last_sample_ms) / 1000.0f;
423:         if (dt <= 0.0f || dt > 0.5f)
424:             dt = 0.02f;
425:         madgwick_update(mgr->imu.gx * 0.0174533f,
426:                         mgr->imu.gy * 0.0174533f,
427:                         mgr->imu.gz * 0.0174533f,
428:                         mgr->imu.ax, mgr->imu.ay, mgr->imu.az,
429:                         mgr->mag.x_g, mgr->mag.y_g, mgr->mag.z_g,
430:                         dt);
431:         mgr->heading_deg = madgwick_yaw_deg();
432:         mgr->heading_mag_deg = mgr->heading_deg;
433:         mgr->mag_healthy = true;
434:         mgr->heading_valid = true;
435: 
436:         {
437:             static int dbg = 0;
438:             if (dbg < 30)
439:             {
440:                 printf("[Fuse] yaw=%.0f mx=%.0f my=%.0f mz=%.0f gx=%.1f gy=%.1f gz=%.1f ax=%.1f ay=%.1f az=%.1f\n",
441:                        mgr->heading_deg,
442:                        mgr->mag.x_g, mgr->mag.y_g, mgr->mag.z_g,
443:                        mgr->imu.gx, mgr->imu.gy, mgr->imu.gz,
444:                        mgr->imu.ax, mgr->imu.ay, mgr->imu.az);
445:                 dbg++;
446:             }
447:         }
448:     }
449:     else
450:     {
451:         mgr->mag_healthy = false;
452:         sensor_fuse_heading(mgr, now);
453:     }
454: 
455:     if (now - mgr->last_als_ms >= ALS_SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS)
456:     {
457:         sensor_update_als(mgr);
458:         mgr->last_als_ms = now;
459:     }
460: }

# contest2026_192_DX

👋 欢迎参加 **2026 首届 openvela AI 硬件开发者大赛**！

这是组委会为你的队伍创建的**专属参赛仓库**（本仓为样例/模板，队伍编号 `192`；你看到的将是你自己的 `contest2026_<编号>_<队伍名>`）。比赛期间，你的全部参赛代码、打包产物与 AI Coding 日志都提交到这里。

> 本仓既是「代码仓」，又内置了一键拉取整套 openvela 工程的 `repo` 清单（manifest）。你只需跟它打交道，**自始至终只动一个文件夹**。

---

## 一、先读这些官方文档

**通用（所有赛道必读）：**

| 文档                                                                                                                                     | 用途                                           |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| [《大赛总览》](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/contest_overview.md)                        | 赛道、流程、评分、资源，建议先通读             |

## 二、第一步：拉取完整工程

用组委会提供的命令一键拉取「openvela 全量源码 + 你的专属仓」：

```bash
repo init -u https://github.com/open-vela/contest2026_192_DX \
  -b dev-ai-contest-2026 -m contest2026_192_DX.xml
repo sync -c -j8
```

同步后，你的整个仓库位于工作区的 `contest2026_192_DX/`，openvela 全量源码在外层（`nuttx/`、`apps/`、`packages/`、`vendor/` 等）。

## 三、第二步：在哪里写代码

**只在自己的仓目录 `contest2026_192_DX/` 里开发。** 不同作品形态放在对应子目录，manifest 会通过 `<linkfile>` 把它们**软链**到 openvela 编译树该在的位置——你不用手动 copy：

| 作品形态 | 你的代码放这里             | 系统自动映射到                                 |
| -------- | -------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| 应用     | `app/hello_app/`           | `packages/demos/contest2026_192_hello_app`     |
| 快应用   | `quickapp/hello_quickapp/` | `packages/apps/contest2026_192_hello_quickapp` |
| 板级适配 | `board/contest_board/`     | `vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_192_board` |

> 用不到的形态目录可以删掉；新增作品时按同样规则加子目录，并在 `contest2026_192_DX.xml` 里补一条 `<linkfile>` 映射即可。**生产仓库（packages/nuttx/vendor 等）零改动。**

建议仓库目录约定（便于评委定位）：

```text
app/ | quickapp/ | board/   # 你的作品代码
logs/                       # AI Coding 日志（主动导出后提交，格式见 logs/README.md）
README.md                   # 作品说明（提交前请改成你自己的，见第六节）
```

> 仓内附带了一个 `.gitignore.example`，给出了**编译产物**等不需要进仓的文件示例。如需启用，`cp .gitignore.example .gitignore` 后按需增删即可。**注意 `logs/` 下最终导出的 AI Coding 日志必须提交，不要忽略。**
>
> `logs/` 的目录结构与提交格式见 [logs/README.md](logs/README.md)。

## 四、第三步：编译与运行

编译/运行步骤随作品形态不同而不同，请参考你所在赛道的教程导航：

- 快应用 / 手表应用：[快应用教程导航](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/quickapp/quickapp_guide_index.md)（含模拟器与开发板部署）。
- AI 硬件产品创新：[AI 硬件赛道教程导航](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/ai_hardware/ai_hardware_guide_index.md)（环境搭建、编译烧录、Skill 开发）。

子目录已通过 manifest 中的 `<linkfile>` 软链进 openvela 编译树，因此构建在 openvela 工作区**根目录**（即你这个仓的上一级）进行。openvela 使用 `build.sh` 作为统一入口，接收一个 **board config 路径**作为参数：

```bash
# 进入 openvela 工作区根目录（你的仓的上一级）
cd ..

# 通用语法：第一个参数是 board config 路径，第二个参数可以是 menuconfig / distclean 等
./build.sh <board-config-path> [menuconfig|distclean] [-j8]
```

> 具体的 board config 路径、目标产物、模拟器/真机部署方式请以你所在赛道的教程导航为准。本仓 `app/` `quickapp/` `board/` 三个示例骨架对应的 Kconfig 选项可通过 `menuconfig` 启用。

1. **fork** 你的专属仓 → 开发 → `git commit` 并推送 → 向专属仓发起 **Pull Request**，可**自行 review 并合入**（无需等组委会）。
2. **AI Coding 日志**：与 AI 工具的对话会自动记录到本机 staging（不会自动上传），需你**主动导出/打包**选定会话到仓内 `logs/` 目录后一并提交。详见[《AI Coding 日志归集与提交手册》](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/ai_coding_log_guide.md)。
3. 若需改动 **nuttx 等公共仓库**，不在本仓改，而是 fork 对应公共仓、以 PR 提交到 `dev-ai-contest-2026` 分支，由组委会 review 后合入。

> ⏰ **提交作品截止：9 月 20 日**。截止后统一收回 push 权限，仍可查看 / clone。
>
> 获奖后再按要求将作品 PR 至 openvela 上游对应仓库（走标准 PR + CI 流程）。

### 关于 PR 与 CLA

- 本仓所有改动通过 **Pull Request** 合入（分支保护强制，可自行合入自己的 PR）。

**总结（约180字）：**

指南针融合用的是 **Madgwick 9 轴 AHRS 库**（`madgwick.h`，陀螺仪+加速度计+磁力计融合成四元数，任意姿态下输出正确航向）；磁力计失效时降级为陀螺仪偏航+重力平面投影的倾斜补偿算法。

工程防护措施包括：
- **陀螺零偏校准**：开机静止 2 秒采样平均，消除偏航漂移主源；
- **重力向量门控**：仅在 |a|≈1g（近静止）时刷新重力方向，避免运动加速度污染；
- **死区+限幅**：偏航角速度 <15°/s 置零，单样本增量限 ±2°；
- **低通滤波**：显示航向按 0.12 系数平滑，融合带 ±2° 死区；
- **健康检查与降级**：磁力计不健康时自动回退陀螺方案；
- **dt 合法性检查**、角度 wrap 处理、模拟器无设备时喂仿真数据。
